thread:
Maria (PM): quick sanity check before we lock GA criteria — customer A is pushing for a 99.9% token-level SLA on Dedicated + Private. can we capture gaps?
Jamal (Eng): 99.9% token SLA = very tight. need to clarify scope: per-request latency SLO vs token-level availability. which one do they mean?
Maria (PM): they wrote "token-level availability" in the contract notes. legal asked us to propose mitigations if we can't meet it.
Oliver (DevEx): from infra side, main ops risks are cold starts (VM/GPU scale-up), degraded quantized models under load, and routing fallbacks causing small model mismatches.
Priya (Support): ops + support readiness: do we have a runbook that maps SLA breaches to remediation steps and customer comms? also need training for L2 on error classes.
Jamal (Eng): proposal sketch: 1) define explicit failure modes covered by SLA (region-down, node OOM, KV cache loss) 2) list exclusions (customer misconfig, malformed requests, DDoS) 3) implement fallback stack: primary model -> warmed lighter variant -> cached responses -> 503 with mitigation ETA.
Maria (PM): can someone draft the SLA wording for legal? short, enumerated exceptions and fallback guarantees. Legal wants measurable metrics.
Oliver (DevEx): I'll draft the wording and include measurable signals: "successful token emission rate" = tokens emitted / tokens requested, and "tail latency percentile" for per-request. Example text: `Successful token emission rate >= 99.9% over rolling 30d window, measured per-customer, excluding scheduled maintenance and documented exclusions.`
Jamal (Eng): engineering constraints: to hit that we need autoscale policy change and warm-pool >= 10% baseline on Dedicated, and pre-pull for Private deploys. Cost impact: ~+12% GPU hours estimate.
Priya (Support): Support playbook items: runbook steps, template customer notification, SLA breach checklist, who calls customer, escalation matrix. Need a doc owner and 2 backups.
Maria (PM): owners: @jamal owns infra changes, @oliver owns SLA wording + docs, @priya owns runbook + comms. timeline: draft by Wed EOD, review Thurs, decision by Friday leadership sync.
Jamal (Eng): quick config snippet for warm pool proposal: 
```yaml
autoscale:
  target_utilization: 65%
  warm_pool_size: 0.10 # 10% of reserved capacity
  prepull_on_deploy: true
```
Oliver (DevEx): we should add observability: token-success metric, model-fallback-count, cache-hit-rate, and a composite "sla_health" gauge. Grafana dashboard + alert when 30d rolling < 99.95%.
Priya (Support): communication templates ready? I can port the incident templates we used for previous pilot. will add SLA-specific lines.
Maria (PM): also need pricing clause: how do we price the warm-pool uplift? finops wants a straight % uplift or separate line item. can someone run a quick estimate?
Jamal (Eng): I'll give a conservative cost delta: +12-15% on committed Dedicated pools; Private depends on customer infra — give them guidance and a recommended configuration.
Oliver (DevEx): small UX ask: expose the SLA status and historical "successful token emission rate" on Console so customer can self-verify. that reduces support toil.
Maria (PM): agree. if we can show a dashboard and an exportable compliance report, legal will be happier.
SRE Bot: deploy triggered: canary rollout to 3% of capacity for warm-pool changes — job#5678 started at 1750000002
Jamal (Eng): canary note — watch model-fallback-count and CPU/GPU mem. I'll annotate the rollout with temporary increased tracing.
Priya (Support): I'll schedule a 30-min walkthrough for L2 tomorrow morning to go over the runbook and sample incident.
Maria (PM): action items recap: Jamal -> infra config + cost estimate; Oliver -> SLA draft + console dashboard spec; Priya -> runbook + comms templates; all -> review Wed afternoon. any blockers?
Oliver (DevEx): none from docs side. I'll include a sample compliance report CSV export format in the draft.
Jamal (Eng): main open: cost acceptability. if finops flags it, we may propose tiered SLA (99.9% paid, 99.5% default).
Maria (PM): ok call that out in the SLA draft as an optional paid tier. thanks everyone.
Priya (Support): noted, will prep templates. :thumbsup:
Maria (PM): thanks — folding into the GA readiness checklist after Doc review.
